text: This was a few years ago, but I have a NSW driver's licence which doesn't state the date you first got your licence. So I had to get my driving history/record from NSW (you can do this easily online) and present it alongside your licence. I went to the Petah Tikva branch because I heard that they process foreign licenses quickly and easily - which they definitely did in my case. Although they did ask for the official record, so it was good I had it.
